# RF-12: Ban Automation

_Triggered actions and modal inputs when a Referrer is banned._

### AUTOMATION

* Ban Reason — Picklist, required: Under Investigation, Confirmed Fraud, Network Policy Violation, Associated with Banned Network, Other
* Ban Notes — Text, always required
* Flag related Player record — Checkbox, optional. Sets the related Player's Review Required and Review Reason fields (see BUILD-177). Banning the Referrer does not restrict the Player automatically — this checkbox is a separate action.
* All unpaid payouts (Status = New or Logged) move to Hold. Payouts already at Paid are not affected. Held payouts do not release on their own — a manual decision to pay or cancel is required.

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* Ban Reason values are confirmed — see [BUILD-232 — Referrer: Ban Button — Confirm Reason/Notes Capture](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217801011390356/f/) for confirmation history.
* Ban Notes-required, the Flag Player checkbox, and the payout-Hold behavior are not separately re-validated with the client — sourced from the prototype's Ban modal only. Not confirmed whether Player's equivalent simplification (inferring the reason from already-flagged records instead of a modal, see [BUILD-175 — Player: Ban Status + Banner](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217686087320935/f/)) should apply here — tied to [BUILD-189 — Referrer: Restriction Detail Fields](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693083539212/f/)'s open question.

### NOTES

* Provenance: RF-12 (Referrer Record User Stories doc).
* Ban Reason values corrected 2026-08-26 to match the confirmed list from the Aug 25 Wagertech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync — the prototype's original values are documented in a comment on this ticket.

### SOURCE

* [Taryn doc RF-12 — Referrer Record User Stories](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MsJXwt3oY-DyQuAdMzNYlyPenKUQl7g8mHzMmeRaVHs/edit?tab=t.lh55xwl5syhi)
* Dependencies: [BUILD-185 — Referrer: Object + Core Status](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693311564006/f/), [BUILD-189 — Referrer: Restriction Detail Fields](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693083539212/f/)
* Related: [BUILD-232 — Referrer: Ban Button — Confirm Reason/Notes Capture](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217801011390356/f/) (BUILD-232 — Ban Reason confirmation history)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Created 2026-08-20 from Referrer record documentation review.

comments.body: **Update:** BUILD-189 now has the banner and a blank Restriction Detail field section (shows when Referrer Status = Banned). Nothing writes to those fields yet. Holding until we confirm the approach.

Corrected the Ban Reason picklist values to match the client-confirmed list from BUILD-232 (08/25 Weekly Sync), replacing the prototype's original values.

For the record, the prototype's original Ban Reason list was: 

* Fabricated/Rogue Referrals
* Edited/Suspicious Proof
* Collusion with Player
* Confirmed Duplicate Referrer
* Policy Violation — Non-Fraud
* Other Fraud/Compliance Concern

**Ban automation built and live in Partial.** Referrer Status sets to Banned automatically. Optional checkbox flags the related Player (Review Required + Review Reason) when checked; Player is untouched when unchecked. Both update steps have fault paths to a shared Error screen. Tested via Debug and the live Ban button, both branches.

**Outstanding:** payout-hold logic — blocked on the Payout object, not yet ticketed, picking up next week once scoped.
